name: com.example.tj_notifyrating.Module_NotifyRating
description: ModuleNotificationRating (Huliganul) prepares optional app rating reminders when the app configures them. It stores the chosen reminder text and icon, and the screen to open when a reminder is tapped.
disableEffect: The effect of disabling this manifest entry on rating reminders is uncertain because the code uses it as a helper, not as an Android screen.
